title: The Old Soldier
text: A veteran sits by the road in rusted mail, back straight, spear upright, waiting for orders from a war that ended long ago. He does not know it ended. He gruffly offers to teach a trick or two to anyone green enough to need it.

options.label: The greenest learns at his feet, while he still thinks there is a war to win.

outcomes.text: He is a hard teacher and a good one. He never once asks their name.

options.label: The Leader relieves him of duty and tells him the war is over.

outcomes.text: He salutes and goes home at last, wherever home is now. The road feels emptier without him.

options.label: Ask him to march with you; a soldier without a war needs one.

outcomes.text: He marches with you as far as the next fight, where he stands in front and fights like ten.
